title: Travel Protection Plans — Acceptance Limits by Plan
content:
Every quotation on the Travel Protection Plans is measured against the acceptance figures the plan itself
carries: the ceiling on the declared trip cost, the age range of the insured travellers, the longest single
journey, the number of journeys a multi-trip plan covers in its year, and the age under which a child travelling
with an insured adult is covered free.

| Plan | Declared trip cost ceiling | Longest journey (days) | Journeys covered in the year | Youngest traveller (years) | Oldest traveller (years) | Children free under (years) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Basics Essential | 5000 | 30 | 0 | 0 | 85 | 0 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 10000 | 45 | 0 | 0 | 85 | 0 |
| TripGuard Plus | 20000 | 60 | 0 | 0 | 80 | 18 |
| TripGuard Premier | 35000 | 90 | 0 | 0 | 80 | 18 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 50000 | 90 | 0 | 0 | 75 | 18 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 15000 | 30 | 12 | 18 | 70 | 0 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 40000 | 60 | 24 | 18 | 75 | 18 |

Trip cost ceilings are in USD. A figure of 0 under "journeys covered in the year" marks a single-trip plan,
which covers the one journey declared on its certificate; a figure of 0 under "children free under" marks a
plan that carries no free child cover at all, and on such a plan every traveller named is premium-bearing.
A youngest traveller of 0 means the plan accepts a traveller of any age up to its ceiling.

## Points of judgement drawn from the schedule

A party whose oldest traveller is 78 falls inside the age range of Trip Basics Essential and Trip Basics
Standard, whose ceiling is 85, and outside that of TripGuard Plus and TripGuard Premier, whose ceiling is 80.
A journey of 75 days is short enough for TripGuard Premier and Cancel For Any Reason Elite, both of which reach
90 days, and too long for TripGuard Plus, which reaches 60. Of the two multi-trip plans, Annual Multi-Trip
Traveller carries the shorter individual journey at 30 days and the smaller trip cost ceiling at 15000, and
Annual Multi-Trip Executive the longer at 60 days and the larger at 40000; both accept only travellers of 18
and over.
